title: 🔆🔅IRGC Navy: Islamic Forces Hold Absolute Control Over Strategic Strait of Hormuz
text:
🔆🔅IRGC Navy: Islamic Forces Hold Absolute Control Over Strategic Strait of Hormuz"

"The commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy, Ali Azmaei, issued a statement in response to what he called false and incorrect claims by US officials regarding the Strait of Hormuz being open. He firmly reiterated that the "warriors of Islam" maintain absolute and decisive control over the strategic waterway."

"The full text of the IRGC Navy command’s message is as follows:"

""In the Name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful."

"The statements made by American officials about the Strait of Hormuz being open are an outright lie, intended solely to manipulate oil prices and to cover up their own failures."

"The dominance of the fighters of Islam over this strategic waterway is utterly decisive. With full strength and complete authority, the Strait of Hormuz is closed to all vessels that intend to transit without prior coordination with the Islamic Republic of Iran."

"We assure the dear, brave, and awakened nation of Iran that this stance will remain in effect until the end of the hostile actions by the US terrorist military against our beloved country and until all stipulated commitments are fulfilled.""

"Voice-over: "Following the announcement at midday on Saturday, August 29, 2026, images of the Strait of Hormuz confirm last night's message from the IRGC Navy regarding Iran's full control over the waterway. We see ships on both sides of the Strait, particularly here in the north. According to the IRGC Navy's announcement, any transit through the Strait of Hormuz occurs by the will of the Islamic Republic of Iran and under the supervision and control of this force. Iran's full oversight of the Strait of Hormuz continues in full force. The ships closer in the images have a shallower draft, while those visible in the distance require a deeper draft and are therefore located in deeper waters. This is the Strait of Hormuz, and these images are exclusively from Fars News Agency.
